//: Documented example config. Copy to .prepass.json and edit. Every field is optional; omitted fields use the defaults shown. Unknown keys are rejected (strict schema). Relative paths resolve against this file's directory.
//models: Logical tier -> concrete model ID. Defaults track the current Anthropic lineup. Point these at pinned versions or OpenAI model IDs as needed.
//curation: Curation controls. maxTokens caps the payload; the builder trims to fit. contentScan reads the head of each candidate and boosts files that mention the prompt's identifiers — with it off, path names are the only signal and ranking degrades to smallest-file-first.
//discovery: How the candidate pool is built before curation ranks it. Uses `git ls-files` when the project is a git repo (so .gitignore is honored exactly), otherwise a bounded directory walk. Disable to consider only explicitly-named files.
//routing: Intent + escalation controls. Below confidenceThreshold, intent falls back to defaultWorkload. The router escalates a tier when the prompt exceeds escalateAboveTokens, the file set exceeds escalateAboveFiles, or confidence is low — unless allowEscalation is false.
//telemetry: Local SQLite (WAL) event store powering `prepass stats`. dbPath lives under .prepass/ which is git-ignored.
//taxonomies: Where workload taxonomies load from. 'dir' holds the built-in <workload>.json files; 'custom' lists extra taxonomy files merged on top (a custom file overrides a built-in with the same workload).
